spans.s:
mfn. (ञ्चन्-ञ्चन्ती-ञ्चत्)
1 Letting go or loose.
2 Shooting, discharging.
E.
मुच to let go, शतृ aff.

m. (-ञ्जः)
1 A sort of grass, from the fibres of which a string is prepared, of which the triple thread worn by the Brahman as a girdle should be formed, (Saccharum munja, Rox.)
2 The Brahmanical girdle, or in common use, the sacred string or cord.
3 An arrow.
E.
मुजि to sound, aff. अच्.

m. (-शः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
मुञ्ज a sort of grass, and केश hair.

m. (-शी)
VIṢṆU.
E.
मुञ्ज the plant, केश hair, and इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
Investiture with the girdle or with the Brahmanical cord.
E.
मुञ्ज, and बन्धन binding.

n. (-रं)
The fibrous root of a lotus.
E.
मुञ्ज a sort of grass, रा to go or resemble, aff. क.
